title: Transmission range pressure switch signal fault
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM detected a combination of transmission range-pressure-switch signals that should not occur during normal operation.
enableCriteria: Ignition on; the reproduced Roadmaster chart states that range signals A and C both indicate zero volts for two seconds.
failureCriteria: An illegal combination of range-pressure-switch inputs is detected.

likelyCauses.cause: Poor contact at a transmission or PCM connector
A range-signal circuit shorted to ground
An internal fault in the range pressure switch assembly

falsePositiveConditions: A connector fault can imitate a failed switch assembly.
confirmatoryTests: Compare the reported range with the selector position.
Check the PCM-supplied voltage at the transmission connector.
Check each range-signal circuit for an unwanted path to ground.
